F.data_reference: definitional; Faraday constant, SN_simple's rounding of the CODATA 2018 exact value 96485.33212 C/mol

T.data_reference: davis2021transcriptomic; Methods (Ch. 2): "All recordings were performed at room temperature" (value not stated; 22 degC assumed); p. 215: neurons died above 30 degC

Cai.data_reference: definitional; resting sub-membrane (shell) Ca 1e-4 mM (Cai_init, cf. wanaverbecq2003plasma) used when unconnected

Ca_mid_m_SK.data_reference: hirschberg1998gating; recombinant SK2 Ca EC50 0.62 +- 0.14 uM (single channel) and 0.63 +- 0.23 uM (macropatch), Results with Fig. 1; native SK 0.5-0.7 uM (Introduction). Was 0.3 uM (cited to gupta2016computational, an SK bladder study); set to 0.63 uM on review (2026-10-02)

Cai_init.data_reference: definitional; resting cytosolic Ca 1e-4 mM (the soma's Cai_init, cf. wanaverbecq2003plasma), the Ca at which m_SK starts

E_K.data_reference: definitional; Nernst potential RT/F ln(Ko/Ki) at Ko 4.5, Ki 200 mM, 295.15 K (the soma defaults; used when unconnected)

V.data_reference: definitional; clamp value when unconnected: the SN resting potential (-70 mV, cf. davis2020downregulation)

A_mem.data_reference: definitional; the soma membrane area 3000 um^2 (used when unconnected; in a soma it comes from the membrane through the membrane_area port)

rho_SK.data_reference: definitional; chosen so that g_KCa_SK = A rho gamma_SK (1e-6 uS/pS) reproduces the previous g_KCa_SK = 0.005 microS (to_be_identified) with A = 3000 um^2 (the soma membrane area) and gamma_SK = 10.3 picoS; a density for calibration through gamma_SK. The previous g_KCa_SK (as proposed in review): unreferenced_placeholder; owner's hand-set value in the SN_simple model (CA token 'to_be_identified')

gamma_SK.data_reference: hirschberg1998gating; rSK2 single-channel conductance 10.3 +- 1.3 pS, inside-out (Results)

p_SK.data_reference: hirschberg1998gating; Results: Hill coefficient 3.2 +- 1.0 (single channel), 3.6 (effective open probability), 4.8 +- 1.5 in macropatches (Kohler et al. 1996); 4 within the range. Previously cited to gupta2016computational (not verified)

tau_m_SK.data_reference: hirschberg1998gating; Results, Fig. 13A: rSK2 macroscopic activation tau 4.1 +- 0.6 ms after a jump to 9.5 uM Ca (deactivation 57.3 +- 11.1 ms; model activation ~5 ms at 5 uM, ~50 ms at 0.5 uM Ca); 5 ms ~ value **(one tau used for activation and deactivation: deactivation is ~11x too fast against the measured 57 ms)**. Previously cited to gupta2016computational (bladder SK model, not verified)

Q10_SK.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; conventional gating Q10 (no effect while T_ref = T)

T_ref_SK.data_reference: hirschberg1998gating; rSK2 in Xenopus oocytes, inside-out patches at room temperature (kinetics as measured; equal to the model temperature)
